definitions.joint_harness_success: Actual full primary body AND valid final primary chain AND strict native original tracing with accepted exact spans, native admission of necessary lineage endpoints, and no silently dropped blocking provenance gaps.
definitions.direct_joint: Null because direct arm has no native trace; full primary and final-chain success is separate.
definitions.model_response_authority: CLI response bytes establish emitted model text. Native CallBudget deepcopies preserve successful responses before host normalization. summary.conclusion: a701 independently passes source tracing while preserving its empirical verification gap. a702 native tracing fails before first accepted analysis; full host sources and completed final forecast do not replace native success.
